answer_1.quote: We propose a fill-in-the-blanks task as an evaluation framework... The decoder uses the semantic representation to generate text corresponding only to the answer to the blank.

answer_2.quote: We use exact match accuracy and ROUGE-1 F1 score (token-level) to evaluate the output of the generation models... For the exact match, we count a generated text string as correct... For the token-level F1, we compute the token overlap...
